title: Document design decisions from review
description: Three design decisions produce documentation obligations with no code changes: ECDH AGREE returns raw Z and the caller must apply a KDF per SP 800-56A before using the output as keying material; GCM nonce reuse is catastrophic and the interface does not prevent it — GEN_IV is the safe path; KEY_EXPORT_PRIVATE returns plaintext and this is a FIPS 140-3 Level 2+ finding.
acceptance_criteria: Programmers guide has a clear warning box for AGREE raw Z with SP 800-56A citation. GCM nonce reuse section expanded with concrete failure consequence and explicit GEN_IV recommendation. KEY_EXPORT_PRIVATE section has FIPS level callout. DESIGN.md updated with the decisions and their rationale.
